headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalOutputFibre_card_le
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TerminalOutputFibre r c U L X) ≤
    Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) *
      (Fintype.card
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) -
        1)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_padded_count_le_twice
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  have U := 11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2);
  Fintype.card
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table
        (fun i =>
          r i +
            OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.rowLargeCount
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) i *
              7)
        fun j =>
        c j +
          OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.columnLargeCount
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) j *
            7) ≤
    2 * Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_defectJoint_card_le
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  have U := 11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2);
  have cellCount :=
    Fintype.card
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U));
  Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U 7) ≤
    2 * (cellCount * (cellCount - 1)) * Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
